content:
CSPM generates the CSPMIOAStreamingEvent for behavior assessment findings regarding potentially malicious behavior.
Note: The CSPMIOAStreamingEvent and CSPMSearchStreamingEvent event types are provided through event stream APIs only after the first time
an assessment finding is discovered for a cloud resource. These event types are not provided after findings discovered during a reassessment.
Note: The CSPMIOAStreamingEvent and CSPMSearchStreamingEvent event types are only available upon request. A Falcon Administrator must
contact
to enable them.
